parked.spanish: Y estas generaciones de Aarón y Moisés en día que habló Jehová a Moisés en monte Sinai.

findings.issue: H854 is the preposition 'with', not the object marker; 'a' makes the clause 'habló a' and drops the accompaniment relation.
Unmarked 'que' only smooths the ביום + finite verb sequence; the packet has no relative token.

parked.spanish: Y los contó Moisés sobre boca de Jehová, conforme a lo que fue mandado.

findings.issue: Pual 3ms צֻוָּה has a masculine singular subject, the one commanded. «lo que fue mandado» makes a neuter content-thing the patient, so the participant who undergoes the command changes.

parked.spanish: Y príncipe de príncipes de Leví: Elazar hijo de Aarón el sacerdote, cuenta de guardantes guarda del santo.

findings.issue: Definite gentilic singular (the Levite) is rendered as the bare proper name Leví, dropping the article and the gentilic.
The noun licenses oversight, charge, or numbering; cuenta narrows it to a tally.
Construct participle and its nomen rectum are juxtaposed without de, so guardantes guarda can be read as apposition rather than keepers of the guard.

parked.spanish: Y darás la plata a Aarón y a sus hijos, rescatados de los excedientes en ellos.

findings.issue: פְּדוּיֵי (H6302) is a masculine plural construct noun in apposition to הַכֶּסֶף. «rescatados» is a passive participle agreeing with «hijos», so Aarón y sus hijos become the rescued party and «de los excedientes» reads as rescued-from rather than the construct ransom of those who exceed.
